title: odd-disclosure
description: One trigger that shows or hides one related region: a native `<details>` and `<summary>`. Disclosures that share a `name` in the same tree form an accordion: opening one closes the others, and adjacent ones draw as one surface.
$comment: Slots: default. A child names a slot with "slot"; text and children without "slot" go to the default slot.

label.description: The summary text; names the disclosure button.

name.description: Exclusive group: opening one closes the others with the same name in the same tree, as native `<details name>` does.

disabled.description: The summary cannot be activated and leaves the Tab order.
